description:
Who We Are 
 At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities. 
 
 The Role 
 Backend Engineering & Delivery
 Architect, build, and scale backend services and APIs using C#, .NET Core, and ASP.NET Core, integrating with legacy systems, third-party APIs, and existing data models.
 Apply clean architecture, SOLID principles, dependency injection, and repository/service patterns to keep systems maintainable, testable, and scalable.        
 Agentic AI Development Practices
 Apply agentic AI development practices-using AI coding agents (such as GitHub Copilot) throughout the development lifecycle-to accelerate backend design, coding, testing, and code review.        
 Implement and maintain agentic development workflows and CI/CD processes, including automated pipelines that leverage AI agents for code review, test generation, and deployment validation.
 Design and maintain backend APIs and services that reliably support agentic and LLM-powered experiences, including streaming responses, robust error handling, and integration with multi-agent orchestration frameworks.
 Collaborate with frontend and AI engineering teams to ensure backend systems integrate cleanly with agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, and real-time data needs.
 Customer Engagement & Solution Integrity
 Partner directly with subject matter experts to understand business challenges, helping to translate complex requirements into high-quality, fit-for-purpose technical architectures.
 Take part in end-to-end technical delivery from scoping and prototyping to production deployment, prioritizing sustainable, long-term outcomes over temporary fixes.
 Bridge engineering rigor with business value, communicating technical trade-offs and solution impact confidently to both technical teams and executive stakeholders.
 Field Intelligence & Platform Contribution
 Systematically capture deployment learnings, document best practices, and share insights to continuously enhance Kyndryl's core AI platforms and frameworks.
 Collaborate daily with engineering leads to improve deployment pipelines and cultivate an open, knowledge-sharing engineering culture.
 Contribute to CI/CD pipeline health for backend build and release processes in Azure DevOps, including branching strategies, environment configuration, and deployment troubleshooting.
 
 Kyndryl currently does not require employees to be fully vaccinated against COVID-19, however, if you are hired to work at a client, customer, or partner location, you may be required to show proof of  vaccination  to align with their respective COVID-19  vaccination  policies.  Those who believe they are eligible may apply for a medical or religious accommodation prior to the start of employment. 
 
 Who You Are 
 Required Skills and Experience 
 5+ years of professional software engineering experience with strong proficiency in C#, .NET Core, and ASP.NET Core (modern versions, not primarily legacy .NET Framework).
 Hands-on experience using AI coding agents and agentic development tools (such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar) as a core part of the software development lifecycle, including implementing and maintaining agentic workflows within CI/CD pipelines.
 Experience designing, building, and integrating REST APIs, including authentication/authorization, error handling, versioning, and JSON-based communication with third-party and legacy systems.
 Practical SQL Server experience, including query optimization, stored procedures where appropriate, Entity Framework/Core, and data modeling - including working with existing complex data models.
 Azure experience, particularly Azure App Services, Functions, Service Bus, Key Vault, Storage, Application Insights, and Azure SQL, along with Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, branching strategies, and environment configuration.
 Experience working on large, enterprise-scale applications with multiple integrations across business domains, including legacy systems and outdated APIs.        
 Understanding of microservices and distributed systems, including messaging/event-driven patterns, asynchronous processing, retries, and resiliency.
 Applies modern architecture and design patterns - SOLID principles, dependency injection, repository/service patterns, and clean architecture - to keep codebases maintainable and scalable.
 Treats automated testing (unit, integration, and mocking) as a core part of development, not something owned solely by QA.
 Zero trust security mindset, including secure API development, secrets management, authentication/authorization, and avoiding common vulnerabilities (OWASP).
 Comfortable diagnosing production issues - from logs and performance bottlenecks to failed deployments and API/database problems - using logging, monitoring, and telemetry tools (such as Application Insights).
 Strong code quality mindset, including participating in code reviews, submitting frequent pull requests, refactoring, managing technical debt, and following team coding standards.
 Ability to understand existing systems holistically and work confidently within a large complex enterprise codebase including integrating with and modernizing legacy systems without assuming everything needs to be rewritten.
 Degree-level qualification in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Informatics, Data Science, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical work experience).
 Preferred Skills and Experience 
 Experience with backend testing frameworks (such as xUnit, NUnit, or MSTest) and mocking libraries (such as Moq).
 Experience using AI agent tools for automated code review, test generation, or refactoring (such as Copilot Workspace, Cursor, or similar agentic coding assistants).
 Experience with event-driven/messaging platforms (such as Azure Service Bus, Kafka, or RabbitMQ) and asynchronous processing patterns.
 T-shaped technical profile with deep expertise in backend engineering combined with broad understanding of agentic AI development practices and enterprise consulting.
 Active technical contributions or feedback provided to core AI platforms, open-source repositories, or internal frameworks.
 Experience modernizing or incrementally improving existing backend systems.
 Active professional certifications in backend frameworks, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), or AI-assisted development pathways.
 Advanced degree (Master's or higher) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a closely related technical discipline.        
 
 Being You 
 Diversity is a whole lot more than what we look like or where we come from, it’s how we think and who we are. We welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. But we’re not doing it single-handily: Our Kyndryl Inclusion Networks are only one of many ways we create a workplace where all Kyndryls can find and provide support and advice. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you – and everyone next to you – the ability to bring your whole self to work, individually and collectively, and support the activation of our equitable culture. That’s the Kyndryl Way. 
 
 What You Can Expect 
 With state-of-the-art resources and Fortune 100 clients, every day is an opportunity to innovate, build new capabilities, new relationships, new processes, and new value. Kyndryl cares about your well-being and prides itself on offering benefits that give you choice, reflect the diversity of our employees and support you and your family through the moments that matter – wherever you are in your life journey. Our employee learning programs give you access to the best learning in the industry to receive certifications, including Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Skillsoft, and many more. Through our company-wide volunteering and giving platform, you can donate, start fundraisers, volunteer, and search over 2 million non-profit organizations.  At Kyndryl, we invest heavily in you, we want you to succeed so that together, we will all succeed. 
 
 Get Referred! 
 If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.
